3.name: Evocation Savant
3.notes:
Add two free level 1–2 Evocation Wizard spells to your spellbook.
Whenever you gain a new level of spell slots, add one free Evocation spell of a level you can cast.

3.name: Potent Cantrip
3.notes: When you cast a damaging cantrip and miss the attack or the target succeeds on its save, the target still takes half damage (no additional effects apply on the failed/full save).

6.name: Sculpt Spells
6.notes: When casting an Evocation spell that affects other visible creatures, choose a number of creatures equal to 1 + the spell’s level. They automatically succeed on the saving throw and take no damage on a successful-save-for-half spell.

10.name: Empowered Evocation
10.notes: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Evocation Wizard spell you cast.

14.name: Overchannel
14.notes:
When you cast a level 1–5 Wizard spell that deals damage, you may maximize its damage dice.
• First use per Long Rest: no drawback.
• Subsequent uses before finishing a Long Rest: take 2d12 Necrotic damage per spell level. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity.
• Each additional use increases the damage by +1d12 per spell level (e.g., second use 2d12/level, third 3d12/level, etc.).
